# Pet Portraits

Pet portraits: turn a photo of your pet from your MegaScenes library into a regal, Renaissance, watercolor or cartoon portrait, keeping its breed, colors and markings.

## What it does
Pick a photo of your pet from your MegaScenes library and the style you want. Claude tells you the price and makes the portrait, keeping your pet's breed, colors and markings.

**How the files are made:** each pet portrait is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Starts from an image in your MegaScenes library: files attached in the chat are not passed to the plugin.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install pet-portraits@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Pet Portraits talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/pet-portrait/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each pet portrait uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The pet portraits show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_pet_portrait_models` | Models for pet portraits with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_pet_portrait_cost` | Exact price of one pet portrait before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_pet_portrait` | Starts one pet portrait in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_pet_portrait` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Turn my latest MegaScenes photo of my dog into a regal portrait"
- "Make a watercolor portrait of my cat from my library"
- "Paint my pet as a Renaissance noble in an oil painting"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the pet portrait (the photo you pick from your library and the style you choose) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
